cases.element: accepted[v1].text "Aun"; errors[e1] "Aún" with feedbackUk "Тут знак наголосу не потрібен: «aun»."; referenceAnswer "Aun"; feedback.incorrectUk
cases.defect: The key is reversed. When aún means todavía, it takes a written accent: "Aún no he terminado los deberes." Unaccented aun means 'incluso'. The task accepts the wrong form, rejects the only correct one, and the feedback teaches a false rule.
cases.correction: Accept "Aún" (v1); move "Aun" to errors with feedbackUk such as «У значенні «todavía» пишемо зі знаком наголосу: «aún».»; set referenceAnswer and incorrectUk to «Aún».
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), §3.4.3.2 aún/aun (from memory)

cases.element: accepted[v2] "hubieron" with noteUk "Теж правильно: дієслово узгоджується з «dos accidentes»."
cases.defect: Existential haber is impersonal: it stays in the 3rd person singular, and "dos accidentes" is its direct object, not its subject. "Hubieron" is non-standard, and the note teaches a false agreement rule.
cases.correction: Remove v2 from accepted; add "hubieron" to errors with feedbackUk such as «У значенні «є/були» haber має лише форму однини: «hubo» (навіть із «dos accidentes»).»
sources: DPD, entry "haber", 4a: impersonal haber used in singular, plural agreement to be avoided (from memory)
cases.notes: Rejecting "había" is fine because the prompt explicitly asks for the pretérito indefinido.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Cannot be settled: 'a las diez' with no part of the day can mean 10:00 (a) or 22:00 (b).
cases.element: clip transcript "Quedamos mañana a las diez en la puerta del cine."; options a (10:00, incorrect) and b (22:00, correct); option a feedbackUk "Ні, зустріч о 22:00."; feedback.incorrectUk
cases.defect: The clip gives no part of the day (no 'de la mañana' or 'de la noche'), so 10:00 and 22:00 are both reasonable. A cinema meeting does not fix the time. The key marks only 22:00 correct and the feedback asserts it.
cases.correction: Make the clip say the part of the day (e.g. "a las diez de la noche") and keep b correct. Or keep only one reading of 'diez' among the options (e.g. 10:00 / 12:00 / 2:00).
sources: Instituto Cervantes, Plan curricular, Nociones generales: tiempo – la hora (from memory)
Course contract, verdict definition for underdetermined readings
cases.notes: Option c feedback "Почуто «a las diez» — о десятій." is understandable; «Ви почули…» would read more naturally.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Cannot be settled: 'se' can refer to Luis (a), to his brothers (b) or to all of them (c).
cases.element: prompt "Ayer hablé con Luis y con sus hermanos. Tenía dos entradas para el concierto y se las di."; option a marked correct, b and c incorrect
cases.defect: The 'se' in 'se las di' does not mark number; it stands for le or les. With Luis and his brothers both mentioned, the recipient can be Luis, the brothers, or all of them. Nothing in the text supports a single key.
cases.correction: Disambiguate, for example "…y se las di a Luis", or make the context leave only one possible recipient.
sources: DPD, entry "se", 1 (se as variant of le/les before lo/la/los/las) (from memory)
Course contract, verdict definition for underdetermined readings

cases.reviewerAnswer: a (vivía) is the expected answer; b (viví) is also grammatical and natural, meaning a bounded period of living there during childhood.
cases.element: option b "viví" outcome "incorrect" with feedbackUk "Ні: тут потрібен імперфект — це фон."
cases.defect: "Cuando era pequeña, viví en Sevilla" is correct, common Spanish: the perfective presents the stay as a bounded episode within the childhood frame. The sentence does not rule this reading out. The choice key rejects a valid answer, and the feedback presents a preference as an absolute rule.
cases.correction: Add context that forces the imperfecto (e.g. "Cuando era pequeña, ___ en Sevilla y todos los veranos íbamos a la playa"), or swap distractor b for a clearly wrong form. At minimum, soften the feedback.
sources: Nueva gramática, §23.12–23.13 (perfective vs imperfective with durative predicates) (from memory)
cases.notes: The Ukrainian «імперфект» is acceptable as a course term.

cases.reviewerAnswer: estaba (but this needs the imperfecto, which has not been taught)
cases.element: prompt "Cuando llegamos, Marta ya ___ en casa."; accepted "estaba"
cases.defect: At A1-03-L3 the learner has only the present of estar. The only accepted answer is the imperfecto "estaba", and the frame needs the past "llegamos" and "ya" — none of these are in taughtBefore. The task tests an untaught form, and the only taught form ("está") is marked wrong.
cases.correction: Use a present-tense frame, e.g. "Ahora Marta ___ en casa." → "está", with error "es". Or move the task to after the imperfecto lesson.

cases.notes: "Tus llaves están ahí, encima de la mesa." is correct. The feedback for hay and ay is accurate.
Style only: in Spain «Buenos días» is used until lunchtime, so the clip translation «Доброго ранку!» could be «Добрий день!». This is not an error.

cases.element: option b feedbackUk "Правильно! «Tengo veinte años» — мені двадцять років."
cases.defect: Option b has outcome "incorrect", but its feedback starts with «Правильно!». The feedback contradicts the option's outcome.
cases.correction: Change it to «Ні: «Tengo veinte años» — мені двадцять років.»
cases.notes: Option c feedback «Почуто…» is understandable; «Ви почули «veinte»…» would read more naturally.

cases.element: prompt example block {spanish: "Mi hermana es médica.", ukrainian: "Моя сестра — лікарка."}
cases.defect: This is a delayed (held-out) task, but the prompt shows the exact target sentence and its translation as an example. The learner can copy the answer, and a delayed prompt must not show a model.
cases.correction: Remove the example block, or replace it with an unrelated model only if the role is changed to "supported".
cases.notes: The open key (closed: false) with unresolvedUk is fine. "Mi hermana es doctora" could be added as accepted.
The note on deber de for supposition matches the normative recommendation and is suitably hedged («частіше»). The Ukrainian is natural.
"delante de mí" is correct. The feedback on "mi" uses the correct term «знак наголосу». The colloquial "delante mío" is not standard and is correctly not accepted.
